name: Regaal Resources Limited
summary: Regaal Resources Ltd. is an Indian corn processor that makes and sells maize starch and derived products. Its range covers native and modified starches, dextrin, maize flour, baking powder, custard powder, icing sugar, liquid glucose, maltodextrin, dextrose and sorbitol, plus co-products such as germ, gluten, fiber and steep liquor. Established in 2012.
